name: Nicole
source:
The most famous blue cat has had a very stressful day. Work, chores... She's completely exhausted and wants to unwind. Luckily, you're here to help her relieve some of that built-up stress.

[from [url=https://linamite.itch.io/nicole-nsfw]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那只大名鼎鼎的蓝猫今天过得压力山大。繁重的工作、琐碎的家务……筋疲力尽的她只想好好放松一下。幸运的是，有你在身边帮她排解积攒已久的压力。

[摘自[url=https://linamite.itch.io/nicole-nsfw]itch.io[/url]]
